data.title: Chinese fugitive with Privilege visa arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police have arrested a Chinese man with an expired visa in a rented house in the middle of a forest on this southern tourist island, after learning was wanted for allegedly running an illegal casino.

data.title: Bayer, GIZ and BCIU collaborate for sustainable, low-carbon rice systems
data.description: Bayer, in cooperation with the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, and together with the Business Council for International Understanding (BCIU), hosted the event "Securing the Future of Rice: Innovation and Partnerships Advancing Food Security, Climate Resilience and Low-Carbon Rice Systems" in Bangkok. On the sidelines of the World Bank and IMF fall meetings, this flagship event brought together government, industry and development partners to discuss the future of rice production in Asia.

data.title: New four-lane bridge opens between China, North Korea
data.description: DANDONG, China - A new four-lane road bridge linking China and North Korea finally opened on Thursday, 12 years late, enabling the Asian giant and its isolated nuclear-armed neighbour to step up cross-border trade substantially.
